verses.text: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
lines: My son, don’t forget my teaching;
but let your heart keep my commandments:

verses.text: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
lines: for they will add to you length of days,
years of life, and peace.

verses.text: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
lines: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you.
Bind them around your neck.
Write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.text: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
lines: So you will find favor,
and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

verses.text: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
lines: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart,
and don’t lean on your own understanding.

verses.text: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
lines: In all your ways acknowledge him,
and he will make your paths straight.

verses.text: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
lines: Don’t be wise in your own eyes.
Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

verses.text: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
lines: It will be health to your body,
and nourishment to your bones.

verses.text: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
lines: Honor Yahweh with your substance,
with the first fruits of all your increase:

verses.text: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
lines: so your barns will be filled with plenty,
and your vats will overflow with new wine.

verses.text: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
lines: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline,
neither be weary of his correction;

verses.text: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
lines: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects,
even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

verses.text: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
lines: Happy is the man who finds wisdom,
the man who gets understanding.

verses.text: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
lines: For her good profit is better than getting silver,
and her return is better than fine gold.

verses.text: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
lines: She is more precious than rubies.
None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

verses.text: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
lines: Length of days is in her right hand.
In her left hand are riches and honor.

verses.text: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
lines: Her ways are ways of pleasantness.
All her paths are peace.

verses.text: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
lines: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her.
Happy is everyone who retains her.

verses.text: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
lines: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth.
By understanding, he established the heavens.

verses.text: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
lines: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up,
and the skies drop down the dew.

verses.text: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
lines: My son, let them not depart from your eyes.
Keep sound wisdom and discretion:

verses.text: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
lines: so they will be life to your soul,
and grace for your neck.

verses.text: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
lines: Then you shall walk in your way securely.
Your foot won’t stumble.

verses.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
lines: When you lie down, you will not be afraid.
Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

verses.text: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
lines: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear,
neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

verses.text: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
lines: for Yahweh will be your confidence,
and will keep your foot from being taken.

verses.text: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
lines: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due,
when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

verses.text: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
lines: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again;
tomorrow I will give it to you,”
when you have it by you.

verses.text: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
lines: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor,
since he dwells securely by you.

verses.text: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
lines: Don’t strive with a man without cause,
if he has done you no harm.

verses.text: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
lines: Don’t envy the man of violence.
Choose none of his ways.

verses.text: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
lines: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh,
but his friendship is with the upright.

verses.text: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
lines: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked,
but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

verses.text: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
lines: Surely he mocks the mockers,
but he gives grace to the humble.

verses.text: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
lines: The wise will inherit glory,
but shame will be the promotion of fools.
